limits: The count limit increases resource allowance but remains finite; a seventeenth historical book requires another explicit design change.
No asynchronous session or public proof schemas were changed. Actual nine-book restore and full live replay are assessed in the final audit.
rationale: The runtime and generator use the same finite 16-book constant and preserve complete prior mechanics. No oldest-book eviction or arbitrary recipe-hash acceptance is added. Existing canonical hash, unchanged world, starter, recipe-result, supplies and reachability checks remain. The generator checks actual UTF-8 bytes before candidate, proposal or package writes; the runtime retains its stat/read 2 MiB guards. Proof length, graph content, session and empty-pair bounds are unchanged.
